'''Thomas Hans Willwacher''' (born 12 April 1983) is a [[Germans|German]] [[mathematician]] and [[mathematical physicist]] working as a Professor at the Institute of Mathematics, [[ETH Zurich]].<ref name="official page">{{cite web |url=https://www.math.ethz.ch/research/mathematical-physics/thomas-willwacher.html |title=Prof. Dr. Thomas Willwacher |website=ETH Zurich |publisher=[[ETH Zurich]] |access-date=25 July 2016}}</ref>

==Biography==
Willwacher completed his PhD at [[ETH Zurich]] in 2009 with a thesis on "Cyclic Formality", under the supervision of [[Giovanni Felder]], [[Alberto Cattaneo]], and [[Anton Alekseev (mathematician)|Anton Alekseev]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|141876}}</ref> He was a Junior member of the [[Harvard Society of Fellows]] from 2010 to 2013.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://socfell.fas.harvard.edu/activities|title=Current and former junior fellows|publisher=Harvard Society of Fellows|access-date=2025-03-03}}</ref>

He joined the [[University of Zurich]] as an assistant professor in 2013, and was promoted to associate professor in 2015.<ref name=ems/>

==Research and recognition==
In July 2016 Willwacher was awarded a prize from the [[European Mathematical Society]] for "his striking and important research in a variety of mathematical fields: homotopical algebra, geometry, topology and mathematical physics, including deep results related to Kontsevich's formality theorem and the relation between Kontsevich's graph complex and the Grothendieck-Teichmüller Lie algebra".<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.euro-math-soc.eu/news/16/07/18/7-ecm-berlin-twelve-prizes-awarded|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210518202650/http://www.euro-math-soc.eu/news/16/07/18/7-ecm-berlin-twelve-prizes-awarded|archive-date=2021-05-18|url-status=dead |title=7 ECM Berlin: Twelve prizes awarded |publisher=[[European Mathematical Society]] |date=18 July 2016 |access-date=31 August 2016}}</ref><ref name=ems>{{cite web |url=http://www.7ecm.de/prizes/laureates.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240912222958/http://www.7ecm.de/prizes/laureates.html|archive-date=2024-09-12 |title=7ECM — Laureates |website=7th European Congress of Mathematics |publisher=[[European Mathematical Society]] |date=July 2016 |access-date=31 August 2016}}</ref>

Notable results of Willwacher include the proof of [[Maxim Kontsevich]]'s cyclic formality conjecture and the proof that the [[Grothendieck–Teichmüller group|Grothendieck–Teichmüller]] [[Lie algebra]] is isomorphic to the degree zero cohomology of [[Kontsevich quantization formula#Kontsevich graphs|Kontsevich's graph complex]].<ref name=ems/>
